name: Frank AI Researcher
description: Remote MCP server for Frank AI Researcher (hifrank.ai): create customer interview studies, run AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers in 50+ languages, and read transcripts and themes in your assistant. Hosted at https://api.hifrank.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth). Available as an app in ChatGPT; also works with Claude, Grok and Muse.
